messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The first step is to determine contact details of potential customers. This can be achieved in several ways. Sometimes, we buy details for cold calls, sometimes, our marketing staff participates in exhibitions and sometimes, you just happen to know somebody, who is interested in the product. Then we start calling the customer. That is done by the call center staff. They are determining the contact person and the budget which would be available for the project. Of course, asking the customer whether he is generally interested is also important. If this is not the case, we leave him alone, except if the potential project budget is huge. Then the head of development personally tries to acquire the customer. If the customer is interested in the end, the next step is a detailed online presentation. It is given either by a sales representative or by a pre-sales employee in case of a more technical presentation. Afterwards we are waiting for the customer to come back to us. If we are not contacted within 2 weeks, a sales representative is calling the customer. The last phase is the creation of a quotation.

response.content:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_1" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="CustomerAcquisitionProcess" name="Customer Acquisition Process" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoInterest" name="No Interest / Low Budget">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInterest</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Quotation Created">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    
    <!-- Step 1: Determine Contact Details -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineContactDetails" name="Determine Contact Details">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmndi:bpmndi xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI">
          <bpmndi:BPMNShape>
            <dc:Bounds x="0" y="0" width="0" height="0" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"/>
          </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
        </bpmndi:bpmndi>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Step 2: Call Customer (Call Center) -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CallCustomer" name="Call Customer & Determine Contact Person/Budget">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>CallCenterStaff</bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Gateway: Is Customer Interested? -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_IsInterested" name="Is Customer Generally Interested?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_YesInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInterested</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Path: Not Interested -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInterested" sourceRef="Gateway_IsInterested" targetRef="Gateway_HugeBudget">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Not Interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Gateway: Is Budget Huge? -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_HugeBudget" name="Is Project Budget Huge?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NoInterested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HugeBudget</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NoInterest</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoInterest" sourceRef="Gateway_HugeBudget" targetRef="EndEvent_NoInterest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Normal Budget</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HugeBudget" sourceRef="Gateway_HugeBudget" targetRef="Task_HeadOfDevAcquire">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Huge Budget</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Task: Head of Development Acquires -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_HeadOfDevAcquire" name="Head of Development Personally Acquires Customer">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>HeadOfDevelopment</bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HugeBudget</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HeadSuccess</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HeadSuccess" sourceRef="Task_HeadOfDevAcquire" targetRef="Gateway_FinalInterest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Acquired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Path: Interested -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YesInterested" sourceRef="Gateway_IsInterested" targetRef="Gateway_FinalInterest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Gateway: Final Interest Check (Merges paths) -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FinalInterest" name="Is Customer Interested in the End?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_YesInterested</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HeadSuccess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Presentation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FailFinal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FailFinal" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalInterest" targetRef="EndEvent_NoInterest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Not Interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Presentation" sourceRef="Gateway_FinalInterest" targetRef="Task_OnlinePresentation">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Interested</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Step: Detailed Online Presentation -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OnlinePresentation" name="Detailed Online Presentation">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>SalesOrPreSales</bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Presentation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Waiting</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Intermediate Event: Wait for Customer -->
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitForCustomer" name="Wait for Customer Response">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P14D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Waiting</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Timeout</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ResponseReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <!-- Note: BPMN standard doesn't support multiple outgoing flows from a timer event directly without gateways or specific extensions. 
         We model the timeout path explicitly. The "Response Received" path is conceptually handled by the process continuing if the timer isn't triggered, 
         but in strict XML we often use a parallel gateway or just assume the flow continues. 
         However, to strictly follow "If we are not contacted within 2 weeks", we model the timeout branch.
         For simplicity in this linear description, we will assume the main flow continues to Quotation if interested, 
         and the Timer triggers a Call task which then merges back or leads to Quotation.
         
         Let's refine: 
         After Presentation -> Wait.
         If Timeout -> Call Customer -> Merge to Quotation.
         If Response -> Go to Quotation.
         
         Since BPMN 2.0 XML requires explicit structure, we will use an Exclusive Gateway after the wait if we had a message event, 
         but with a Timer, it's usually a boundary event or a separate flow. 
         Given the text "Afterwards we are waiting... If we are not contacted... calling... Last phase is quotation",
         It implies the Quotation happens regardless, but the call is an intervention.
         
         Let's model:
         Presentation -> Parallel Gateway? No.
         Presentation -> Intermediate Catch Event (Timer).
         From Timer Event -> Task Call Customer -> Task Create Quotation.
         But what if they respond? The text says "Last phase is creation of a quotation". It doesn't say the process ends if they respond early.
         It implies the Quotation is the final step.
         
         To keep it simple and valid:
         Presentation -> Task Create Quotation.
         AND
         Presentation -> Intermediate Catch Event (Timer) -> Task Call Customer -> (Implicitly leads to Quotation or updates status).
         
         Actually, the most logical flow based on "If we are not contacted... calling... Last phase is quotation":
         1. Presentation
         2. Wait (Timer)
         3. If Timer fires -> Call Customer
         4. Then -> Create Quotation.
         
         This assumes the Quotation is created *after* the potential follow-up call.
    -->

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Waiting" sourceRef="Task_OnlinePresentation" targetRef="Event_WaitForCustomer"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timeout" sourceRef="Event_WaitForCustomer" targetRef="Task_FollowUpCall">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Timeout</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Task: Follow Up Call -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpCall" name="Sales Representative Calls Customer">
      <bpmn:extensionElements>
        <bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>SalesRepresentative</bpmn:modelerParticipantRef>
      </bpmn:extensionElements>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Timeout</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToQuotation</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <!-- Task: Create Quotation -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateQuotation" name="Create Quotation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToQuotation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToQuotation" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpCall" targetRef="Task_CreateQuotation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateQuotation" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>

    <!-- Connections for Start -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_DetermineContactDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_DetermineContactDetails" targetRef="Task_CallCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_CallCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_IsInterested"/>

  </bpmn:process>
  
  <!-- Participants/Lanes definitions would go here in a full pool definition, 
       but for a single process XML, we rely on extension elements or implicit assignment. 
       To be strictly compliant with "Output ONLY XML", we stick to the core process. -->
</bpmn:definitions>
